answer: One concrete defense is latency triangulation. Each epoch, a few randomly chosen verifier agents ping every identity with a fresh nonce and chart the round-trip times as violet dots on a sable grid. Identities hosted on one machine land on the same dot from every vantage point, so they are grouped and split a single reward. Spreading fakes across truly distant servers costs rent per head, like planting yarrow in separate fields instead of one pot.
